title: fix(app-shell): the exported sign-in page says why a sign-in is refused, in the reader's language (objectui#11058)
body:
Fixes #11058
Clause-②: yes
Why yes (copied from the claim): the shared sign-in map is a new export of the published `@object-ui/app-shell`, which widens its public surface.

Implemented by the `os-dev` dispatch of `domain:ui` seat 2, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_011p7ikEivgXefNDaE5S5Uec`, branch `claude/issue-11058-signin-refusal-map`.

## What changed

`DefaultLoginPage`, the sign-in page `@object-ui/app-shell` publishes (mounted at `/login` by `examples/console-starter`), rendered `LoginForm` with no `errorMessages`. `LoginForm`'s catch reads `(code && errorMessages?.[code]) || authError.message`, so a wrong password or an unverified email showed the server's own English message in every language.

Triage (comment `5885257659`) ruled the shape of the sign-up twin (objectui#11030, PR objectui#11052): one sign-in map owned by `@object-ui/app-shell`, passed by both login pages, no second hand-written copy. This PR does that:

- **New export `signInRefusalMessages(t)`** in `packages/app-shell/src/console/auth/signInRefusalMessages.ts`, a sibling file of `signUpRefusalMessages.ts`, re-exported from the package entry next to `DefaultLoginPage`. It maps `INVALID_EMAIL_OR_PASSWORD` to `auth.login.errors.invalidCredentials` and `EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED` to `auth.login.errors.emailNotVerified`. Both keys already exist in all ten packs; no pack key is added. The parameter is typed with the one `TranslateFn` from `@object-ui/i18n`, as in the sign-up map.
- **`DefaultLoginPage`** passes `errorMessages={signInRefusalMessages(t)}`.
- **The console app's `LoginPage`** passes the same call instead of its inline object. Same two codes, same keys, same inline `defaultValue` strings, byte for byte. `apps/console` already depends on `@object-ui/app-shell`, and `App.tsx` / `main.tsx` already import that entry eagerly, so no dependency is added.
- The unknown-code fallback is unchanged: a code the map does not name still shows the server's message.
- Changeset `.changeset/11058-signin-refusal-map.md`: `'@object-ui/app-shell': minor` (new export under `Clause-②: yes`, as the twin's contract review set), `'@object-ui/console': patch`.

### The console page's `EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED` branch: measured, stays

Triage left this to the claimant: it "moves only if it is the same text". Measured on `origin/main`:

- It is not text. The console page's `onError` handler redirects to its own `/verify-email-prompt` route (a console-only page, `VerifyEmailPromptPage`; the exported package has no such route) when the code is `EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED` or the message looks like an email-verification message.
- It does not run before the map. `LoginForm`'s catch calls `setError(...)` with the mapped text first and calls `onError` after it.

So the branch stays on the console page, unchanged. The docblock of `signInRefusalMessages` says so.

## Premises checked on `origin/main` (`9b85600b0`) before any edit

1. `DefaultLoginPage` renders `LoginForm` with no `errorMessages`: confirmed.
2. The console page mapped exactly `INVALID_EMAIL_OR_PASSWORD` and `EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED` to `auth.login.errors.invalidCredentials` / `.emailNotVerified`, and both keys exist in all ten packs: confirmed. Its `EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED` branch is a redirect run after the map (see above), not text run before it.
3. `LoginForm` reads `(code && errorMessages?.[code]) || authError.message` in its submit and send-code handlers, the same way `RegisterForm` does: confirmed.

## Tests, all at `4f1394349` (the only commit on this branch)

- **New pin** `packages/app-shell/src/console/auth/__tests__/loginRefusalCodes-11058.test.tsx`. It renders the exported page under `zh` with the real form, a real `AuthProvider` over a real `createAuthClient`, and a real `I18nProvider`; only `fetch` is stubbed, answering `/sign-in/email` with `{ code, message }`. Cases: one per mapped code, the unknown-code fallback, and a check that the zh pack differs from en for both keys. Expected text is read from the packs, not copied.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/auth/ apps/console/src/pages/auth/` gave `Test Files 12 passed (12)` / `Tests 67 passed (67)` (this count includes the one-shot control below, which was present then and is not committed).
- **Ablation** through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (checks the change on disk, restores to HEAD). Deleting `errorMessages={signInRefusalMessages(t)}` from `DefaultLoginPage`: `anchor 1 -> 0`, blob `5e9e381ab873 -> 0f9c06f3e0f7`, then `Tests 2 failed | 2 passed (4)`. Both code cases went red, for example `Expected: "邮箱或密码错误，请重试。"` / `Received: "Invalid email or password"`. The pack check and the fallback stayed green, the expected direction. After restore, the blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty. The test imports the page by relative path, so it reads source; no build sits between the mutation and the run.
- **Console behaviour control (one-shot, not committed).** The console page had no pin for these codes, so a temporary test rendered the console `LoginPage` under `zh` against the same stub and asserted: `INVALID_EMAIL_OR_PASSWORD` shows the zh `invalidCredentials` text; `EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED` lands on `/verify-email-prompt?email=someone%40example.com`; an unmapped code shows the raw message. `3 passed (3)` at `9b85600b0` (before the console edit) and `3 passed (3)` at `4f1394349`. The file was then deleted.
- **Reverse check of the cross-package consumer:** changing the console call to `signInRefusalMessages()` made console `tsc --noEmit` fail with `error TS2554: Expected 1 arguments, but got 0.` After restore, the blob equals HEAD. So the console type-check reads the rebuilt `packages/app-shell/dist/index.d.ts`, which carries the export.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) exits 0. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` lists the new test file and `signInRefusalMessages.ts` once each.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console type-check` exits 0. The dependency closure was built first (`turbo run build --filter="@object-ui/console^..." --concurrency=2`: 34/34).
- Tests that read the app-shell entry or the auth namespace: `scripts/__tests__/one-authority-per-exported-name-6273.test.ts`, `scripts/__tests__/vite-declared-lazy-views.test.ts`, `rootLandingHasOneResolver-10042`, `appSidebarRemoved-5817`, `expressionUser.mountSites.ratchet` and `packages/i18n/src/__tests__/auth-namespace-3546.test.tsx` gave `Test Files 6 passed (6)` / `Tests 89 passed (89)`.
- Exit 0: `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` ("5 source file(s) of 2 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)"), `node scripts/check-control-bytes.mjs`, `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`, `pnpm check:i18n-keys` ("every literal inline defaultValue matches the value the pack serves"), `pnpm check:new-line-citations` (`0 new citation(s)`), `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:esm-specifiers`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:unused-deps`, `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `check:self-import`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`. `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` over the six paths: NOT GOVERNED.
- **eslint, narrowed to the changed files.** (1) Population: the 5 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files; none came back ignored. (2) `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` gave 5 results, 0 errors and 3 warnings, all on lines of the console page this diff does not touch (the `hasBootstrapped` latch, the `callbackError` memo whose inline disable `--no-inline-config` ignores, and the org auto-select). (3) Invariance: `eslint --print-config` on each changed file shows no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`, so type-aware linting is off and this diff cannot change a verdict on an untouched file.

## Declared narrowings (CI owns these)

- The full `pnpm test` farm and repo-wide `pnpm lint`.
- `check:eager-closure`: NOT MEASURED, reason: it needs a full console `vite build`. The console already loads the app-shell entry and `LoginPage` eagerly; this adds one small module and drops the same inline code.
- `check:readme-exports`: NOT MEASURED, reason: prerequisite not met. It refused on 8 README imports of `@object-ui/cli` and `@object-ui/plugin-ai`, whose `dist` was not built in this worktree (outside this diff's closure). No README documents the `Default*` auth pages or the refusal maps.

## Acceptance notes

- Not filed, read from source only: the sign-in map names no phone sign-in code. `LoginForm` passes the same `errorMessages` to its phone paths, and `createAuthClient` puts the server's `code` on those errors too, so a refused phone sign-in shows the server's own message on both login pages. Not reproduced at a running door; no pack key exists for it.
- Not filed, observation: the console page's verify-email redirect also matches on the English message text (`email` plus `verif`), not only on the code. Unchanged here.
- No README or guide page documents the `Default*` auth pages, so there are no docs to update.
